title: Ability status was a raw phase enum on the phone
body: controller printed WINDUP/ACTIVE/RECOVERY next to the energy number; core now publishes status (OUT/ARMING/PRIMING/ACTIVE/COOL Ns/LOW ENERGY/AUTO/READY).

title: Phone must read ability.status instead of composing its own word
body: controller/index.html:138 still builds ARMING/phase/COOL/LOW ENERGY/AUTO WHILE MOVING itself and appends ' / '+energy (unitless number). Replace with ab.status; drop the energy number (the meter shows it). Seam: controller/index.html.

title: Ability names have no budget
body: Added AbilityNameBudgetTest (<=15 chars, unique, not a car/weapon/consumable name).

title: Mine is both a weapon and the Mechanic's ability (Mine vs Mine Dispatcher); Turbine ability vs Turbo reserve consumable vs Hot fuel
body: Two names for near-same boost/drop things. Product decision on a rename (e.g. ability 'Auto Mines', consumable 'Boost reserve').

title: Ability names are nouns, not verbs (Shoulder, Scrambler, Flywheel)
body: Button says the thing, not what it does: Scrambler (slick patch), Shoulder (ram charge), Flywheel (surge). Rename to verb-led short names or add a one-word effect line per ability.

title: No presentation event for ability active / ready-again / blocked press / weapon overheat lock
body: PresentationKind.ABILITY fires only at windup. Ready-again, a rejected press (arming, cooldown, low energy), and the weapon heat lockout/resume have no event, so TV and phone cannot cue them. Adding enum values breaks the exhaustive when in RaceAudioDirector.kt:92-101 (game), so needs a coordinated change. DESIGN: one coordinated card. New kinds proposed: ABILITY_ACTIVE, ABILITY_READY, ABILITY_REFUSED(detail=reason), WEAPON_LOCKED, WEAPON_RESUMED. Exhaustive when sites a new PresentationKind breaks: game/src/main/kotlin/dev/deathride/game/audio/RaceAudioDirector.kt lines 91-101 (when(event.kind) used as an expression, one branch per kind, no else) - add a branch (or else->continue) for each; the if-chains at 103-104 are non-exhaustive and safe. Test sites using kinds non-exhaustively: core PresentationEventsTest, TrackQualitySimulation.kt:130-138 (check for exhaustive when). Emit sites: Abilities.activate, Abilities.begin phase transitions, Combat.kt:239 (lock) and :249 (resume). Events never hash; emit only when presentationEvents.enabled.

title: Weapon heat: over (bool) and heat (0..1) leave HOT vs OVERHEATED vs COOLING unnamed
body: weaponStatesJson sends cd/heat/over only; while locked the weapon cools at a different rate to a resume fraction, so heat falling with over=true is indistinguishable from normal cooling. Expose a state word (READY/HOT/LOCKED/EMPTY) from core like statusLabel and let phone/TV render only that. Seam: game RaceGame.kt:974 weaponStatesJson. CONSUMER SEAMS (not built, outside paths): (1) game/.../RaceGame.kt ~974 weaponStatesJson add ,\"state\":\"<c.weaponStatus(id,w)>\" next to over; (2) controller/index.html:132 ready() and :134-136 compose their own over/cooling/hot logic: read fs.state instead (also removes the duplicate EMPTY/FIRING branches).

title: Four in-race barks over one caption line (60+ chars)
body: bark.mica.a5.marrow 83, bark.rook.grudge.wrecked 80 (repeats a sentence), bark.vex.ally.grid 70, bark.mica.noname 67; 32 announcer lines over 60 too. Core resource lines.csv must equal narrative/lines.csv (ScriptTest), so the edit lands in narrative/ first. Add a bark/taunt <=64 budget test with it. AUDIO NOTE: announcer lines are Callum noir voice rows; rewording any line with a recorded counterpart (rec.* / recorded-keep|replace) means a re-record, so this is lane C: owner decides cut vs re-record. Barks are UNCAST drafts and can be shortened freely.

title: Speaker name for unknown speakers is uppercase of the id
body: Script.speakerName maps only voice/mechanic/house; relay and clerk speakers would show RELAY / CLERK without the article/role used elsewhere. Add explicit names.

title: Weapons have no display name; the phone shows the id (Rivet/Hammer/Scatter/Mine)
body: weaponName is Weapons.id; weapons.csv has no name column and no verb. Add a name column (e.g. RIVET gun, HAMMER shell) via the table, tests budget it.
